purchase_notes: Confirm bearing construction seal and measured seat before ordering
Inner diameter is approximate and must be measured first
Envelope exists but impedance power connector and acoustic requirements are unknown
Exact model; check regional stock and remember retail input is 3.7 to 6.0 V
Buy only after installed fastener schedule is dry-fit
Each XL330 package lists six M2x6 horn bolts; count included stock first
Each XL330 package lists ten M2x8 frame bolts; count included stock first
Length is inferred from mesh depth and needs dry-fit confirmation
Confirm where through-bolting is accessible
Select insert OD and length only after coupon testing
Use only where measured holes confirm M2.5
Confirm horn hardware included with every servo before buying separately
Axle diameter material and retention are not fixed
Spacer and washer stack depends on measured wheel side play
Use only after confirming compatibility with printed polymer and inserts
Choose Wi-Fi 3W not Ethernet-only 3E and confirm RAM storage and header option
Use high-endurance storage only if the chosen Radxa SKU has no suitable eMMC
Official board is unavailable; replacement must be designed and fabricated
Use orderable LSM6DSV16XTR after package and assembly review
MCU selection follows firmware timing and package requirements
Select half-duplex circuit only after the one-servo interface prototype
Do not order a PCB before schematic review ERC and DRC
Official HAT is not sold; replacement design is required
Stack height and through-hole orientation must match the mechanical design
Do not select a host interface until automatic turnaround is proven at 1 Mbps
Logic regulator selection depends on combined Radxa camera and sensor load test
Servo regulator current rating is blocked on one-servo and five-servo measurements
Confirm pack mass clearance protection behavior and selected NP-F size
Confirm contact polarity retention and current rating
Fuse type and rating require measured normal and fault current
Switch voltage current and breaking rating require measured load
Protection topology must be designed and fault-tested
Capacitance voltage rating and ESR depend on scope captures
Confirm Radxa ribbon pinout and current runtime overlay before ordering
Ribbon contact orientation pitch and routed length are unresolved
SATEL kit is for evaluation and may be too large; verify mechanical integration and driver compatibility
Cable type and length depend on the selected ToF module
MAX98357A is only the output-only safe-replica option and does not provide microphone capture
Microphone electrical acoustic and connector requirements are unresolved
Each XL330 package includes one 180 mm X3P cable; measure routing before making custom lengths
Buy only for custom cable lengths after the harness drawing is frozen
Verify wire gauge and crimp tooling before ordering production quantity
Wire gauge insulation flexibility colors and total length remain open
Choose a known data-capable USB-C cable and verify maskrom flashing
Zero 3W has onboard wireless; confirm selected antenna SKU before buying anything else
Select rigid material only after strength creep and insert coupons
Select TPU shore hardness only after friction and tear coupons
Any dimensionally stable low-cost filament is acceptable for fit prototypes
Exact official adapter for single-servo ID and baud configuration
Choose a current-limited supply with logging after expected range is fixed
Choose a reputable meter with continuity and protected current measurement
Choose at least two channels and enough bandwidth for 1 Mbps TTL edges
JST lists YC-260R or equivalent tooling for SEH-001T-P0.6; verify source and cost
Choose temperature-controlled soldering and hot-air tools appropriate for the selected packages
Choose a calibrated 0.01 mm display caliper from a reputable local supplier
Stand geometry depends on final robot mass envelope and emergency access
